links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified cancer patient education content from 34 NCCN Member Institution websites
links.outcome: Mean readability grade level (Fry, Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG); content quality (DISCERN section 2) and similarity/accuracy as secondary outcomes
links.effect: Mean readability fell from grade 13±1.5 (university freshman) to grade 9±0.8 (high school freshman). F1 0.87, precision 0.934, recall 0.814. Cosine similarity to originals 0.915 (95% CI 0.908-0.922). Mean DISCERN of AI content 28.5±5 ("good"), with no significant difference from originals.
links.tradeoff: Recall of 0.814 versus precision of 0.934 suggests some original content was not retained in the rewrites. Quality (DISCERN) did not differ significantly from the originals.
links.quote: However, after ChatGPT's intervention, the AI-generated outputs had a mean readability score equivalent to a high school freshman education level (grade 9±0.8).

design_hint: reading-level simplification of patient-facing content with LLM
